auth_check.reason: No login/credential endpoint exists in the state map or endpoint catalog; the recording carried no session cookies or authorization headers (unauthenticated fixture app), and scope.json does not set authentication_required: true.

findings.title: Replaying refund completion must not pay the customer twice (order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount)
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> POST refund/request -> POST refund/complete -> POST refund/complete (replay) -> GET order. Invariant sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount evaluated from the final GET.

findings.title: Cancel order + complete refund must not double-reimburse the same order (order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount)
findings.evidence: Co-visible in baseline: Cancel order + Request refund. Three bracketed scenarios from clean states (refund-then-cancel, cancel-then-refund, concurrent cancel/refund race), each ending in a full GET and asserting sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount. Cites observed-UI rule UIR-001 (price protection gated while a refund is active).

findings.title: A second refund request on an already-completed order must not stack a second payout
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> POST refund/request -> POST refund/complete -> POST refund/request (second) -> POST refund/complete -> GET order. Invariant sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount from the final GET.

findings.title: Refund completion must require a prior refund request (no payout for an un-requested refund)
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> POST refund/complete directly (no refund/request) -> GET order. Cites observed-UI rule UIR-002 (Complete refund only appears after a refund request exists). The workflow-gating bypass claim is not fully proven by the monetary bound alone, so the workflow aspect is NEEDS_REVIEW; the executable monetary check is sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount.

findings.title: Refund request/complete must not honor a client-inflated amount (order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount)
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> POST refund/request with tampered body {requestedAmount:100000, completedAmount:100000, originalAmount:5,...} -> POST refund/complete -> GET order. Invariant sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount from the final GET. The recorded request was bodyless, so request-field acceptance is uncertain and stays NEEDS_REVIEW.

findings.title: Price adjustment + refund must not push cumulative reimbursement past originalAmount
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> POST price-adjustment with tampered body {adjustmentAmount:100000,...} -> POST refund/request -> POST refund/complete -> GET order. Invariant sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount from the final GET. The price-adjustment endpoint was not exercised in the recording, so its request-field schema is unknown; request-field acceptance stays NEEDS_REVIEW.

findings.title: Cancel order must not honor a client-inflated cancellation reimbursement amount
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> POST cancel with tampered body {reimbursementAmount:100000, status:completed,...} -> GET order. Invariant sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount from the final GET. The cancel endpoint was not exercised in the recording, so its body schema is unknown; request-field acceptance stays NEEDS_REVIEW.

findings.title: Concurrent identical refund requests must not stack multiple payouts
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> 5 concurrent POST refund/request (asyncio.gather) -> POST refund/complete -> GET order. Invariant sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount from the final GET.
